description: Replaces .github/dependabot.yml. That file carried a note worth keeping:
Dependabot has no sbt support, so the sbt build is maintained by Scala
Steward instead (PR #36 'Dependency updates' comes from it, not from here).
Renovate DOES understand sbt, so it could take that over as well. It is
deliberately not enabled: Scala Steward is already working on this repo and
running both against build.sbt would duplicate every PR -- the same clash
this migration exists to end. If Steward is ever retired, drop the
enabledManagers line below and Renovate will pick up build.sbt.

packageRules.description: Was the github-actions 'actions' group (patterns: *), weekly on monday at 07:00 Europe/Stockholm, limit 5, 'ci' commit prefix, labels dependencies + github-actions. Its comment read: 'Bundle related action bumps into a single PR - less PR noise, one CI run.'
